title: Hailey Bieber's Advanced Glute Bridge Variation Is Giving Booty Goals On Instagram | Health and Fitness News - News18
text: Hailey Bieber has cemented herself as the queen of trends, as the model shares her beauty and lifestyle tips with her fans very frequently on social media. She lives a very unfiltered life online and posts the raw and real behind-the-scenes from her day. Sometimes this can include her makeup routine, her smoothie and food order or even her gym workouts. Recently, the model and mum of one took to Instagram Stories to share a glimpse at her workout. The 29-year-old was wearing a cute workout set – which included a grey sports bra and matching long pants – to the gym. A pair of black and white Adidas shoes completed her gym girl look. Hailey Bieber shared a clip of her doing a variation of a glute bridge – a popular exercise when wanting to work on your glutes, aka the group of three major muscles – the gluteus maximus, medius, and minimus – located in the buttocks and hip region. They act as the primary and powerful stabilisers for the pelvis and lower body. They enable movements like walking, running, standing from a chair, and climbing stairs. At the gym, Hailey Bieber was doing her variation of a glute bridge. She had placed two gym benches in front of each other, with a torso-length distance between them. She placed her upper body on one bench and added a resistance band on her thighs to add some more burn to the workout. Placing her feet on the second bench and having a wide stance, she did the exercise in a slow and controlled manner after placing a heavy dumbbell on her pelvis. What Is A Glute Bridge? The glute bridge is a powerhouse bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, hamstrings, core, and lower back. This foundational, no-equipment exercise strengthens the glutes, hamstrings, core, and lower back by lifting your hips off the floor while lying on your back. They are highly effective for correcting muscle imbalances, reducing lower back pain, and activating the posterior chain, making them ideal for both rehabilitation and strengthening. How To Do A Glute Bridge? Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart (6-12 inches from glutes). Brace core, squeeze glutes, and lift hips until shoulders-knees form a straight line. Hold 1-2 seconds at top, lower slowly. Avoid arching back or pushing through toes—aim for 10-15 reps x 3 sets. Main Benefits Of Glute Bridge Glute Bridge Variations
